This position may involve working with technology, software, or other items subject to U.S. export controls regulations. Under these regulations, it may be necessary for Oceaneering to obtain a U.S. government export license prior to releasing such items to certain persons. Oceaneering also complies with applicable U.S. economic sanctions laws and regulations, which can restrict Oceaneering’s ability to employ certain persons. As such, this position may be contingent upon Oceaneering verifying a candidate’s residence, U.S. person status, and/or citizenship status. If Oceaneering determines that a candidate’s residence and/or citizenship/non-U.S. person status will require a license or prohibit the candidate from working in this position, Oceaneering expressly reserves the right to either consider the candidate for a different position that is not subject to such restrictions, on whatever terms and conditions Oceaneering shall establish in its sole discretion, or, in the alternative, decline to move forward with the candidate’s application. In accordance with the above policy and to ensure compliance with applicable U.S. sanctions and export controls regulations, Oceaneering asks the following questions in order to verify your residence, U.S. person status and/or citizenship status: Are you currently physically located in or residing in any of these countries/locations: Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, or the Crimea, Donetsk People’s Republic (DNR), or Luhansk People’s Republic (LNR) Region of Ukraine?

To ensure appropriate compliance with legal requirements and Oceaneering's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, Applicants are required to disclose any situations that may involve conflicts of interest. A "conflict of interest" occurs when an Applicant's personal interests interfere, or appear to interfere, in any way with the best interests of Oceaneering. A conflict can arise as a result of an Applicant holding outside work or making financial investments that make it difficult to perform work for or on behalf of Oceaneering objectively and effectively. Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging We are committed to cultivating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment where all employees can be their authentic selves and fully contribute to meet the needs of our employees, members, and the communities we serve. Representation is critical to this goal. At Blue Shield, we hold ourselves to a high standard for equitable and inclusive hiring practices. Blue Shield of California is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, or protected veteran status. The next four sections will ask you to self-identify on some aspects of your identity. Your responses will be reported in aggregate only. Please be assured that your responses (or choosing not to identify) will have zero impact on your candidacy; this information is always stored separately from your application and is maintained confidentially. If hired, this information may be used on a very limited & strictly need to know basis to extend targeted professional development opportunities. Self-identification is voluntary.
